adjudication.rationale: The new addGuests input schema allows an unbounded array (`guests: z.array(z.string().email())` in `addGuests.schema.ts`) and the handler will `createMany` attendees and send emails based on that list (`addGuests.handler.ts`), so a reviewer can reasonably flag the lack of a maximum size as a potential abuse/perf concern. However, the claim about “no rate limiting” is not fully verifiable from this diff because rate limiting could be enforced in shared TRPC/procedure middleware not shown here.
